the diagram and when; not required
Completeness = number of atomic data points marked MET ÷ 77
MD vs TVD. MD (measured depth) is distance along the borehole; TVD
(true vertical depth) is the vertical depth of the same point. A row's MD and
TVD cells are one datum in two measurement types, scored as two points,
not duplicates; rows with no TVD cell are non-depth items. W01 is
directional but reports MD only, so every TVD point is MISSING. Repeated
data are framed at one representative instance.
Records who prepared the diagram and when.
